injection.title: AegisAI — Instructions suspectes répétées
injection.query: sum by (tenant_id, user_id) (count_over_time({job="aegisai",service="backend",event_type="prompt_injection_suspected"} | json tenant_id="tenant_id", user_id="user_id" | __error__="" | tenant_id!="" | tenant_id!="null" | user_id!="" | user_id!="null" [5m])) or vector(0)

agent.title: AegisAI — Échecs d’appel aux agents
agent.query: sum by (target_service) (count_over_time({job="aegisai",service="backend",event_type="agent_call_failed"} | json target_service="target_service" | __error__="" | target_service=~"water-agent|energy-agent|gas-agent" [2m])) or vector(0)
